rules.text: Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px.
rules.read_back: Whenever the robot drives forward, there must be at least 80 pixels of free space ahead of it before a wall or building, and whenever it drives backward, there must be at least 80 pixels of free space behind it; if it doesn't drive at all, neither requirement applies.

deleted_starters.text: Never fire a shot you can't afford.
Only fire at a robot you saw this turn, with the gun aimed at it.

explanation.headline: Proved: the one rule (S3) holds
explanation.summary: Verus proved S3, "Never drive toward a wall or building closer than 80 px": the code only drives ahead when clearance_ahead is at least 80, and only backward when clearance_behind is at least 80. The battles did record violations of S1 (open arena, turn 176, 1 turn) and S2 (open arena from turn 0 for 12 turns; urban from turn 0 for 23 turns), but those rules were not part of the checked rule set here, so they say nothing about S3, which was never broken.
